crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
translations.bsb: Now Balak said to Balaam, “Then neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”
translations.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
translations.asv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
